title: Expose AUTO_PRD_SAFE_SCRIPT_DIRS in config and TUI
overview:
Users cannot configure allowed Python directories through the UI; they must manually edit environment variables.

**Motivation:** Improves user experience by allowing configuration through the standard TUI Settings interface instead of requiring manual environment variable editing.

**Technical constraints:**
- Add SafeScriptDirs field to Config struct in config.go
- Update runner.go to read from config instead of just environment
- Add TUI input field in Settings tab

**Signals:** priority: critical
problem_statement: Users cannot configure allowed Python directories through the UI; they must manually edit environment variables.

technical_constraints: Add SafeScriptDirs field to Config struct in config.go

resolution_notes: Already implemented. SafeScriptDirs is fully integrated: defined in config.go with SafeScriptDirs field and GetSafeScriptDirs() method, TUI has inSafeScriptDirs input field with accessors in keys_settings.go, rendered in view_settings.go, and wired in run.go via parsePathList(). The feature provides complete TUI configuration for safe script directories.
